# Astral Fantasy prototype asset provenance

- `heroine.webp` and `heroine-{happy,concerned,determined}.webp`: manual transparent silhouette extraction from the user-supplied `Subculture Style Mobile RPG Game UI - MinJeong Kim.jpeg` (736 × 414). Cutout is scaled 2× for display; no claim of new detail. The reference interface is excluded. Variants are subtle color/cheek visual-state treatments, not redrawn facial-expression animation. These supplied reference derivatives are for the local prototype; commercial usage rights have not been supplied.
- All `.svg` files: original procedural illustrations and ornamental icon concepts authored for this local Astral Fantasy project. Gradients, grain, architecture, leaves, lighting and details are authored SVG; no external downloads, stock assets or generated art service used.
- `observatory.svg`, `village.svg`, `forest.svg`: original scalable atmospheric compositions, not copies of reference interface artwork.
- `world/hero.svg`: original illustrative chibi inspired by the supplied protagonist color/silhouette; not an extracted game sprite.
- The other supplied JPEG files are design references only and are not embedded in runtime assets.
- Source builder: `tools/art/build_assets.py`, deterministic random seed 241125.
- Runtime assets contain no embedded lettering, clickable UI, or network dependencies.

## Limitations

The original SVG art is a richly layered local prototype fallback, not a replacement for commissioned high-detail painted anime environments. Portrait emotional differences are grades; true facial-emotion redraws and frame-by-frame character animation remain production tasks.
